title: Cook Authentic Chinese Feast in Houston (Includes 4-Course Meal)
blurb:
Step into a welcoming Houston kitchen and experience the flavors of authentic Chinese cooking in this interactive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the workshop introduces essential skills and bold recipes that go beyond takeout.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Hot and sour soup with shiitake mushrooms and tofu
- Appetizer: Crispy shrimp toast with a savory shrimp filling
- Main course: Sesame chicken or beef coated with sesame seeds
- Side dish: Vegetable fried rice with colorful vegetables

With step-by-step guidance from your local chef, you’ll gain confidence in seasoning, frying and layering flavors to recreate these dishes at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy alongside their meal in a relaxed, small-group setting.
